exposure: Disease severity (quiescent to mild vs. moderate to severe)
cohort: 2058 women with IBD (UC: 1469, CD: 589) and 20,580 age-matched controls without IBD
finding: While the incidences of adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with IBD are generally similar to the general population, moderate to severe IBD is associated with increased risks of adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was significantly increased in women with CD compared to controls, and in those with moderate to severe IBD compared to controls and those with quiescent to mild IBD.
